chargePolicies.title: Charge policy
chargePolicies.subtitle: Whether incident costs are charged to the customer: never, as a proposal or automatically.
chargePolicies.noPermission: You do not have permission to view the charge policy.

documentRules.subtitle: Which transport document (delivery note or CMR) an order receives by default.
